jen_finance: Heads up — we're rolling out a billing alignment and invoice cleanup across regions. Effective 2024-05-15. This affects how line items show up and how legacy free credits are displayed. No service interruption expected. Please read and share. @alex_ops @sam_product @support_ravi

alex_ops: Quick q — does this change any rate limits or quota behavior for hosted endpoints?

jen_finance: Short answer: no hard quota changes. We are moving to finer-grained metering (per-minute billing granularity and minor rounding updates). Per-route throttles and SLA bands remain unchanged.

sam_product: Can we get a sample invoice fragment so CS/Finance know how to map items?

jen_finance: Yep — sample below. Console will show a billing preview on May 1.

jen_finance: ```
Invoice 2024-05-15
- Hosted API - US (tokens): 1,234,567 tokens @ $0.0005 = $617.28
- Minute-level metering adj (US): 320 minutes @ $0.10 = $32.00
- Regional surcharge (APAC): $12.00
- Legacy free credits applied: -$25.00 (expires 2024-06-15)
Total: $636.28
```

support_ravi: Need a KB + canned replies. I'll draft one and link here. Also flagging customers on active trials so we can proactively message.

maya_legal: We must send a 30-day notice to impacted customers for the credit expiry. I'll prepare the legal-safe copy for the email and add CCs for Sales.

billing-bot: [automated] Migration job scheduled: 2024-05-15T02:00:00Z. Affected sets: legacy-free-tier, per-minute-conversion-optins. Estimated window: 2 hours.

jen_finance: Timeline recap: announcement today -> billing preview in Console on 2024-05-01 -> targeted emails to affected accounts week of 2024-04-15 -> enforcement (invoices reflect new format) on 2024-05-15. We'll keep a 90-day grace cushion on overage notifications for startups (detect and notify rather than bill immediately).

alex_ops: Action items for Eng/Console: update invoice export CSV schema, add field `metering_granularity`, and surface 'preview' flag. I'll own these changes.

support_ravi: I'll add a troubleshooting checklist. Edge cases to watch: customers with custom contracts, enterprise billing integrations (SFDC/Zuora exports).

sam_product: We'll add an alert that flags accounts with >10% invoice delta month-over-month so CSMs can reach out. Also need to update pricing FAQ.

jen_finance: Thanks — internal owners: Finance (jen_finance), Ops (alex_ops), Support (support_ravi), Legal (maya_legal), Product (sam_product). Please add any concerns here. I'll post the customer email drafts by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
